description: Tier-2 reuse of exactly-matching attested proofs (GX-31, B-20 (b), D-070 under GA-P02 strict, P-43): the train reuses a verified v4 gate.passed only when its input_digest is the one the train recomputes for the judged commit. Reader: scripts/lib/train_reuse.py (the train's judge path, GX-30).

train-reuse.reuse_attested_proofs.description: GX-31 (D-070, GA-P02 strict, P-43): before a tier-2 run (the batch head or a bisection probe) the train looks for a gate.passed at the v4 proof version on the repository channel, read through a forge adapter that keeps only trusted author associations (the port re-validates every event_id), whose input_digest, head tree, base, plan, selection, attested toolchain_id (GX-28) and gate_version equal the ones it recomputes; a match is the verdict and nothing runs, anything else runs. Off is the one-key rollback: tier 2 never reuses (D-065 (5) as before GX-31).

train-reuse.tier2_plan.description: GX-31 (D-070): the plan a tier-2 run binds into its proof (scripts/gate-batch runs gate-local --dev, so the binding's plan is dev). The train puts it in the input_digest it recomputes; a value that is not the gate's makes every lookup miss (the run happens), never a false reuse.
